subject: FLOAT-BINARY clause
notes: HIGH-ORDER-RIGHT specified: implied for every standard binary float item without its own endianness-phrase - FLOAT-BINARY-32/-64 images become little-endian (13.18.60.4 GR19b) via NumProfile.FloatLittleEndian; COMP-1/COMP-2/FLOAT-SHORT/-LONG/-EXTENDED stay big-endian (GR19c scopes the clause to the standard usages). The golden discriminates byte order with FUNCTION ORD reads (a round trip alone is self-inverse). Per-item phrase: kb/Work PB174.
